response.justification: Bogdan meets minimum experience requirements with 15+ years in software engineering and a technical degree. His current role at re:cinq involves AI infrastructure and agentic workflows, and he demonstrates entrepreneurial leadership through founding GISCollective. However, the role explicitly requires director-level strategic leadership with recognized AI expertise, neither of which are clearly evidenced. His AI experience is recent (current role only, ~4 months), he lacks a Master's/PhD in AI/ML, and his resume emphasizes hands-on engineering over the strategic customer advisory and product visioning central to a principal engineer position.
strengths: 15+ years of full-stack software engineering with proven mastery across diverse technologies and domains
Strong entrepreneurial credentials from founding GISCollective platform, demonstrating technical vision and open-source community leadership
Current hands-on involvement with AI infrastructure and agentic workflows; demonstrated ability to mentor others through workshops and technical talks
concerns: AI platform expertise appears limited to current role (4 months), lacking established track record of recognized AI innovations or delivered AI products
Missing Master's degree or PhD in AI/ML-related field, which is a stated preference for this specialized AI strategy role
Career progression emphasizes individual technical contribution over director-level strategic thinking, customer advisory experience, and technology visioning required for principal engineer role

key_factors.factor: Lack of Director-Level Strategic Leadership Track Record
Strong Technical Foundation with Entrepreneurial & Leadership Experience
